sentences.en: Agriculture is defined as the cultivation of soil for growing crops.
sentences.zh: 农业被定义为耕种土地以种植作物。

sentences.en: The city of Mako was a centre for the cultivation of onions.
sentences.zh: 马科市是洋葱的栽培中心。

sentences.en: Organic cultivation is a method of growing plants (grains, vegetables, fruit, etc.) without using agricultural chemicals.
sentences.zh: 有机耕种是一种不使用农用化学品来种植庄稼（谷物、蔬菜、水果等）的方法。

senses.zh: 耕作，耕种 - 栽培；养殖 - 教化，培养 - 教养，修养；文雅
